subject: Vendor onboarding: invoice delivery, PO mapping and filename conventions
messages:
From: Natalie Green <natalie.green@inkdeliver.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2025-08-12T09:15:00Z
Subject: Vendor onboarding: invoice delivery options and PO mapping

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We're finishing our onboarding paperwork and want to confirm Redwood's preferred invoice delivery process and PO mapping requirements so our AP team can format invoices correctly.

A few quick questions:
- Does Redwood prefer emailed invoices (to an AP inbox), SFTP transfer, or vendor portal upload?
- If emailed, any required subject line or filename convention?
- Is the PO number required on the invoice for automatic matching? If so, should it be the PO on the header or line-level?
- Any mandatory fields (remit address, tax ID, GL code) we should include?

I've attached a sample invoice and our vendor contact for AP: accounts-payable@inkdeliver.com. Also attached our W-9. Please let us know the best way to submit a test invoice so we can validate ingestion.

Thanks,
Natalie Green
Director, Finance Operations
InkDeliver LLC
accounts-payable@inkdeliver.com
Attachment: Sample_Invoice_InkDeliver.pdf

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2025-08-13T14:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: invoice delivery options and PO mapping

Hi Natalie — great to hear from you and welcome. Short answers up front, then specifics: we accept emailed invoices to a dedicated AP inbox and also support portal uploads for larger partners. For onboarding, email is easiest.

Requirements for automated processing:
- Send invoices to: ap@redwoodinference.com
- Subject format we prefer: INV [VendorName] [PO#] (example: INV InkDeliver 12345)
- Filename: PDF, one invoice per PDF. Prefer: RDW_INV_[VendorShort]_[PO#].pdf
- PO number: required for automatic PO-match. Header-level PO is fine; line-level PO numbers are supported but not required unless the PO contains multiple releases.
- Mandatory fields: invoice date, invoice number, PO number, remit address, vendor tax ID (or W-9 on file).

If there's no PO (occasionally for expense reimbursements), include the purchase request or attach the PO placeholder document.

Could you send a test invoice using the subject and filename above? I've attached our Vendor_Onboarding_Form_Redwood.docx — please complete and return via DocuSign link if possible.

Thanks — I'll loop in AP to confirm ingestion window once we see the test.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachment: Vendor_Onboarding_Form_Redwood.docx

Hi Natalie — perfect, thank you for the attachments and the test invoice. Confirming final rules so there's no ambiguity: 

1) Ingestion endpoint: ap@redwoodinference.com — please use that for production invoices until we complete portal onboarding.
2) Subject line: must start with INV + vendor name + PO (example: INV InkDeliver 12345). We'll use subject parsing for auto-routing.
3) Filename: single PDF per invoice. Preferred pattern: RDW_INV_[VendorShort]_[PO#].pdf (we will accept minor deviations but files that lack a PO or vendor identifier will be routed to manual review).
4) PO mapping: header-level PO is sufficient for auto-match. If one PO has multiple releases, include release/reference in a separate field ("Release:" or line-level PO column).
5) Mandatory fields to appear on the PDF: invoice number, invoice date, PO number, remit address, vendor tax ID or W-9 on file.
6) GL codes: vendors do not need to include GL codes. Finance will map PO -> GL during posting.

Next steps: please sign and return the onboarding form via DocuSign (link: https://www.docusign.com/inkdeliver/vendor-onboard/abc123). Once we receive your test invoice and the completed form, AP will run ingestion during the next scheduled batch and confirm whether the file parsed cleanly. I'll attach our internal Invoice_Formatting_Guide for your reference.

Let me know if you want a quick 15-min screen share for the test.

Best regards,
Priya Natarajan
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachment: Invoice_Formatting_Guide.pdf
